withdrawnVersions.reason: The plugin claimed Gateway's unique shared /api RPC interceptor and broke Desktop welcome API requests. The old packed RPC-only checks did not cover Gateway coexistence.

notes: This record consumes the successful frozen pre-final packed test on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (cordis 4.1.0) built from the Settings-section delivery and the search-to-install repair. Its complete payload and SHA256 remain in external evidence to avoid a self-referential hash.

The Client half no longer registers a sidebar panel entry or a keyed main panel. It registers one settings.section row (id skillre-skills-manager, order 25) plus the matching settings.section.icon, so DSH's own Settings seat owns navigation and the plugin owns only the page.

The target UI was verified in a real DSH Web page: an owned temporary non-Desktop web profile booted the packed tarball, a real Chrome connected through CDP, and 19 checks passed. The left rail had no skills entry, the Settings sidebar showed the Skills row and opened the manager page, a real skills.sh search hit resolved into the full repository review (SKILL.md, resources, target) in one action, and two off/on cycles restored the Settings row and page with a clean console. This is not an Electron Desktop visual acceptance check.

Mount checks match the 0.2.1 record: real Gateway settings/describe and Desktop welcome llm/listConfigurableProviders, plugin list/detail/check/remove/restore with actual filesystem/fingerprint checks, a real owned Host restart while installed, dependency/selection/composition/plugin-route absence after uninstall, and owned-process/profile cleanup verification.

88 automated tests pass, covering the new search-hit resolution and install-conflict decisions, the install directory override, optional token scoping, GitHub rate-limit messaging, discovery ref caching and the zero-API archive fallback, plus the existing transport, archive, batch/backup and lifecycle regressions.

Only current DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 on the macOS isolated non-Desktop CLI/Web carrier was mounted. Desktop shell exact-Fetch dispatch is supported by the inspected SDK and real registry tests, not a live Electron acceptance check. The user's daily profile and Desktop restart remain user-verified.
